who.value: seller (or bidder) promoting a timed auction

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Share this auction' with a collage carrying '432 bids · Auction ends 9 Sep, 9PM' and app icons makes it a share sheet.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: App names, 'Download', 'Copy link' and 'Shuffle' are clear, but 'More' is vague and 'Collage' / 'Single image' don't say they only change the image.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Only the preview and destinations show.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Labels and icons carry the screen; no explanatory text.
